events.title: Azar Lawrence Experience at Bach Dancing & Dynamite Society
events.why: Adult-oriented: saxophonist Azar Lawrence plays the legendary beachfront jazz room in Half Moon Bay, a Sunday-afternoon coastside institution.

events.title: Blankets and Blockbusters: Toy Story 5 outdoor screening
events.why: A Sunday afternoon outdoor movie on the Thrive City plaza, bring blankets.

events.title: Día de los Muertos Festival: Altars & Folklórico at Courthouse Square
events.why: Redwood City's big Día de los Muertos night with community altars, folklórico dancers and a lowrider display, 15 minutes from Menlo Park and drew 9,000 people last year.

events.title: Helicopter Adventure at Hiller Aviation Museum
events.why: A one-off helicopter-themed program at the Peninsula's aviation museum, fifteen minutes up the 101.

events.title: LoveFest SF: Free 7-Hour Reggae Festival & Food Drive
events.venue: Spreckels Temple of Music Bandshell, Golden Gate Park
events.why: All-ages outdoor reggae afternoon in the park; bring canned food for the drive.

events.title: Muchos Art + Comic Expo (50+ artists)
events.venue: La Peña Cultural Center, 3105 Shattuck Ave
events.why: A free all-ages indie comics and zine fair with Pentel-sponsored drawing workshops, ideal for a comics-loving kid.

events.title: National STEM Day Free Community Day at The Tech Interactive
events.venue: The Tech Interactive, 201 S Market St
events.why: The whole museum is free today with extra community booths and bonus activities, a rare no-cost visit to a top kids' science museum.

events.title: Redwood City Día de los Muertos Festival
events.why: Casa Círculo Cultural's free festival drew 9,000 people last year with altars, folklórico, a car display and food, ten minutes from Menlo Park.

events.title: San Francisco Diwali Festival at Yerba Buena Gardens
events.why: Free afternoon Diwali celebration with dance performances, food and festival-of-lights activities for families.

events.title: San Francisco Veterans Day Parade
events.venue: North Point & Jefferson St to Aquatic Park, Fisherman's Wharf
events.why: Once-a-year parade along the Wharf with marching bands, military units and vintage vehicles, free and easy for kids to watch.

events.title: Palo Alto Veterans Day Recognition Event
events.venue: MacArthur Park Historical Building, 27 University Ave
events.why: Small-town civic ceremony with the Stanford Mendicants a cappella group and a Quilt of Honor presentation, five minutes from Menlo Park.

events.title: Petaluma Veterans Day Parade and Huey helicopter flyover
events.why: A small-town parade with a Vietnam-era Huey landing and aircraft flyovers, the largest Veterans Day parade north of the Golden Gate.

events.title: San Jose Veterans Day Parade (108th, largest in Northern California)
events.why: Held since 1918, this is the largest Veterans Day parade in Northern California and falls on a school holiday.

events.title: Veterans Day aboard the USS Hornet
events.venue: USS Hornet Sea, Air and Space Museum, 707 W Hornet Ave
events.why: A ceremony with guest speakers on the deck of a real aircraft carrier, plus full access to the ship on a day off school.

events.title: Arab Film Festival Outdoor Movie Night: Spices and Lies
events.why: Free outdoor screening of a French-Algerian food rom-com with shawarma and kunafa vendors, marking the festival's 30th anniversary; RSVP required.

events.title: Menlo Park Storytelling Festival: StoryFest Online
events.why: The hometown library's annual storytelling festival streams a lineup of live tellers for all ages, a free weeknight option without leaving the house.

events.title: Bhangra & Beats Diwali Night Market
events.why: The City's official Diwali night market, billed as a family-friendly Indian rave with DJs, dance and street food, free and all ages.

events.title: Cubberley Artist Studio Program Open Studios
events.why: Twenty-three resident artists open their studios with an AR asteroid sculpture, a FOPAL book sale and an Oaxacan food truck, ten minutes from Menlo Park.

events.title: Friends of the Menlo Park Library Autumn Book Sale
events.why: Twice-a-year sale of thousands of books, kids' titles and DVDs mostly priced $1 to $2, right in town; also Friday Nov 13, 14:00 to 17:00.

events.title: Gamble Garden Second Saturday: Seeds and Indigenous Heritage Month
events.why: Free hands-on garden morning making seed bracelets and seed bombs and exploring acorn traditions, with a plant sale; timed-entry registration.

events.title: Holidays at Filoli Opening Day
events.why: First day of Filoli's holiday season, with a new Family Farm of mini cows and goats in the redwoods, 200+ decorated trees and a Celtic-themed house, 15 minutes from Menlo Park.

events.title: Kuchipudi Dance with Manaswini Avvari
events.why: Free one-hour classical Indian dance performance at the local community college, a short cultural outing close to home.

events.title: Peninsula Youth Theatre: The Wizard of Oz
events.venue: Mountain View Center for the Performing Arts, Main Stage
events.why: Opening weekend of the local youth theatre's full-scale Wizard of Oz, with performers the same age as your kids; also 19:30 Saturday and 13:00 Sunday.

events.title: Renegade Craft Holiday Fair
events.why: 250+ curated makers plus food trucks in one indoor hall, a strong early holiday-shopping outing; also Sunday Nov 15, $5 suggested donation.

events.title: Rhône By The Bay Wine Tasting
events.why: ADULTS ONLY (21+): 44 Rhône Rangers wineries pour about 150 American Grenache, Syrah and Viognier bottlings in a walk-around tasting.

events.title: Rock the Dock Concert Series: Pop Rocks
events.venue: Port of Redwood City, 459 Seaport Court
events.why: Final free waterfront concert of the season at the Port, with food vendors and room for kids to roam; county listing says 14:30, port site lists series slots at 15:30, so confirm start time.

events.title: SF Tea Festival at the Ferry Building
events.why: Taste hundreds of teas from 30+ vendors with a souvenir porcelain cup included; also Sunday Nov 15 and $5 off with code FUNCHEAP.

events.title: SF VegFest 2026
events.why: 27th annual plant-based food festival with 80+ exhibitors, chef demos and comedians, a good grazing day for curious eaters.

events.title: The Big Open: 100+ Sausalito Artists Open Studios
events.why: Once-a-year weekend when 100+ working artists open their waterfront studios; also runs Sunday Nov 15.

events.title: Feathered Friends: Birdwatching & Nature Art for Families
events.venue: San Francisco Botanical Garden, Main Gate
events.why: Early-morning guided birdwatching on fall migration plus a nature-art session; $40 covers one adult and one child ages 5 to 12, so suits the 9-year-old.

events.title: Neave Trio at Kohl Mansion
events.why: Adult-oriented: acclaimed piano trio in the Great Hall of a 1914 Tudor mansion, with a free pre-concert talk at 18:00 and $30 tickets for under-30s.

events.title: Palo Alto Youth Council Mental Health Fair for Parents & Teens
events.venue: Mitchell Park Community Center, 3700 Middlefield Rd
events.why: Teen-run fair with youth mental health experts, therapy dogs and free refreshments, designed for parents to attend with their teens.

events.title: Shadelands FallFest
events.why: Free try-it sports sampler for kids with food trucks, shelter animals and a pink fire engine, good for active 9-to-14-year-olds.

events.title: Menlo Park Storytelling Festival: Jeff Gere, True Supernatural Tales of Hawaii
events.why: Touring Hawaiian storyteller performs spooky true tales at the hometown library as part of the free annual festival; check the library calendar for the start time.

events.title: Embarcadero Center Holiday Market & 40th Annual Building Lighting
events.why: The once-a-year moment when all four Embarcadero towers light up for the holidays, paired with a holiday market, kicking off the season downtown.
